title: The Small Harbor
author: Rafael Sterling
blurb: Theo Pemberton, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
